submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Repaint ONE new independent run/NE/16 game animation frame from EDIT TARGET image1. Images2 portrait identity,3 NE idle orientation,4 approved painted style. Keep exact target head/face/body/prop pixel sizes, fixed full-canvas camera and root center. NE means rear-three-quarter running AWAY to upper-right, back of head and back costume visible, no visible frontal eyes/face. Do not turn into side-E or frontal-SE.
The camera-near anatomical RIGHT shoulder connects to RIGHT hand holding exactly FIVE red/gold rectangular flame talismans. Camera-far anatomical LEFT shoulder connects LEFT hand holding one bronze bell/red tassel. Trace both shoulder-elbow-wrist-hand chains, arms swing opposite to legs; do not simply switch props between screen sides. Exactly two arms/hands and two articulated legs/shoes, no third cuff, secure fingers on handles/card bases. Preserve five fan panels, no sixth sliver.
PHASE: RIGHT initial contact linking to frame01. Near RIGHT heel/outer rear sole touches the invisible perspective ground plane, knee begins flexion, front of right shoe nearly level. Far LEFT recovery leg bent behind, heel lifted toward camera and sole partially visible at lower-left. Near RIGHT fan arm lowers alongside RIGHT hip on SCREEN RIGHT, near RIGHT sleeve remains attached to SCREEN RIGHT shoulder; far LEFT bell arm stays attached to SCREEN LEFT shoulder, slightly forward and partly occluded. This is early touchdown before full weight compression next cycle, with visible support contact and separated airborne left shoe. No duplicated stance, independently redraw subtle phase.
Hold the NE target's whole-canvas framing, apparent skull size, costume design and ground reference, root x512 and virtual near ground around y920 at1024; perspective far foot may appear slightly higher than near foot. Movement of knees/hips causes modest head/pelvis bob, not resizing or moving a flat cutout. Preserve brown high ponytail ruby crown, rear waist knot, short red-gold flame robe, black trousers and red-black-gold shoes. Robe, ribbon and bell tassel trail travel naturally. Show actual contact/absorption/push-off where specified, not perpetual flying.
Single square native >=1024 RGBA sprite, transparent background. No floor, shadows, glow, particles, text, grid or labels. Bright clean rounded richly hand-painted Taoist chibi style. No mirror, copied pose, warp, frame interpolation or contact sheet.
MANDATORY CORRECTIONS: Target has SIX cards including a thin extra panel. Repaint the fan with exactly FIVE complete red cards, five distinct outer corners, five flame faces, no sixth sliver. Keep anatomical RIGHT fan sleeve attached to SCREEN RIGHT shoulder exactly as target. LEFT bell sleeve attaches SCREEN LEFT shoulder. Never exchange hands to achieve swing. Both shoe heel-to-toe longitudinal axes project along upper-right travel direction, with ankles aligned to knees, NO outward-toed/V-shaped feet. An airborne shoe may show its sole due to knee flexion, but its toe axis still follows the direction of running. Only independently repaint the pose, preserve fixed camera and full-canvas sizes.
